exposure: Trophectoderm biopsy prior to frozen blastocyst transfer
outcome: Rate of birth weight over 4000 g
cohort: 145 women with viable singleton gestations after autologous frozen blastocyst transfer in programmed cycles (67 after blastocyst trophectoderm biopsy, 78 without biopsy)
finding: Trophectoderm biopsy prior to frozen blastocyst transfer in programmed cycles was not associated with adverse obstetrical outcomes related to gestational age at delivery, birth weight, or cesarean rate.
mod_finding: Trophectoderm biopsy prior to frozen blastocyst transfer was not associated with differences in cesarean rate.
birth_weight: Median birth weight: 3420g (biopsy group), 3430g (no biopsy group)
